architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit fixture architecture: const=0, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, ws2=5 (addrsize 4, wordsize 2), join=6, iop=7 (x86-64-shaped ram/register sizes); heap-allocated spaces owned by ~AddrSpaceManager (translate.cc:492-502)
compiler_spec: none: JoinSpace::printRaw / AddrSpaceManager::findAddJoin / findJoin are pure space-manager methods; no Funcdata, P-code, or cspec input

analysis_options.api: Direct JoinSpace::printRaw via rudra::space::AddrSpace::print_raw dispatch and findAddJoin/findJoin via rudra::space::SpaceRegistry (the registry-side manager_join tables, translate.hh:233-235 placement); no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference is normalized or removed. Both sides print the join offset unpadded lowercase hex and the printRaw result string verbatim (including the brace/comma pieces form, the ':logicalsize' float-extension suffix, the wordsize-2 '+cut' suffix inside the braces, and the 'Unlinked join address' throw text). The dedup line prints offset identity on the Rust side where Ghidra prints JoinRecord pointer identity — equivalent because unified offsets are unique per record (monotonic allocation plus splitset dedup).
analysis_options.random_seed: none; printRaw, findAddJoin and findJoin are deterministic

cases: join_printraw: the pieces forms of JoinSpace::printRaw (space.cc:590-609) — 2-piece register pair {0x00000018,0x00000010}, findAddJoin dedup (identical pieces -> same record/offset), 3-piece ram+register+register {0x00001000,0x00000020,0x00000022} (ram 8-byte offset shrinks to the 4-byte field via the >>32 rule), 1-piece float extension {0x00000100:4} (the loop szsum discarded in favor of the unified logical size, space.cc:604-606), and the wordsize-2 piece recursion {0x00000080+1,0x00000030} (byteToAddress scaling + '+cut' inside the braces)
join_allocation: the 16-byte-rounded allocation sequence (translate.cc:706-710) locked through observable offsets 0x0/0x10/0x20/0x30 (case 1) plus a fresh 5th record allocating 0x40

join_printraw_unlinked: printRaw on a join offset with no JoinRecord throws LowlevelError('Unlinked join address') (translate.cc:761); the Rust side panics with the same text, caught and printed identically, panic-hook stderr suppressed
reachability_note: no production pipeline path registers a join space in the registry or prints a join-space address through AddrSpace::print_raw today (heritage reads the separate arch.join_db, which is never populated; no join-space Address is constructed in the E2E closure), so the E2E C output cannot regress from this specialization; the fixture locks the behavior ahead of the ADDRESS-0001 consumer migration that will wire it into production
